rationale: Selective prototype workloads improve across six complete five-pair cases. Production transfer is separately qualified, retaining the original unrelated regression and the reverse-order repetition. Actual production update/block experiments improve subsequent insertion in two different distributions; rule-upsert time itself is not optimized.
scope: Only an explicitly configured single raw view selects the join. Other view sets use the existing staged strategy, with diagnostics. No regex engine, syntax, flags, translation or dependency change.
limits: Source extraction is capped at 256 bytes and 255 distinct keys per row. This is not a bound on total row-by-rule fanout, global memory or output size; engine memory/time limits remain required.
incomplete_performance_controls: No-needle prototype baseline timed out after three paired rounds; long-value baseline failed its memory limit in warmup. These are censored, not full performance gates or speedup ratios. Production semantic fallback controls pass separately.
update_scope: Existing regex/view/needle tuples rotated among stable IDs. Physical deletion and reinsertion also checked. Concurrent rule-update isolation was not measured.
